purpose.reconstruction: Exact Brendan reconstruction from semantic slot programs
purpose.generation: Parameterized mutation of the same semantic construction grammar

derived: semantic slot proposals from measured bands and centerline
interpretation: semantic anatomy labels are hypotheses / author assignments
palette roles are heuristic RGB classifications; palette topology is measured

parameterization.transform: nearest-neighbor integer mapping inside slot bounding boxes; feet use authored bilateral contact primitive

notes: Brendan exact mode does not call canonicalRowRuns.
Semantic slot programs are the reconstruction source for v0.7 Brendan mode.
Uttkarsh starter is a parameterized construction-language variation; it is not claimed to be a portrait likeness.
